messages:
Simran: heads-up — noticed some tenants with console 'pin to version' enabled are seeing weird quota attribution when we autoswitch routing. example header we see: `x-redwood-client-version: v1` but traffic goes to v2 pool and billing shows v2 usage. anyone seen this?
Jorge: saw one signal earlier, looked like a sticky route mis-evaluating the pin on fallback. wondering if the routing proxy strips the pin on async retry.
Maddie: is this affecting the console badge+billing preview? We show pinned version in UI but the cost preview might be calculated from last-served model.
Eli: yup — a few invoices flagged by finance. main problem: quota meters count by final model id (model:v2-quant) whereas console UX expects charge to follow the pinned route.
Priya: deploy-bot reported a recent patch to the fallback path (rollforward) at 1763218000 that changed header forwarding behavior.
deploy-bot: patch deploy v1.24.3 -> v1.24.4 applied to routing-proxy; changed header sanitization for retries.
Simran: ok that explains it. two folks: 1) quick mitigation for affected tenants (console-only) 2) longer-term fix in proxy + dashboard to make attribution transparent. proposals: add telemetry tag for "claimed_pin" vs "effective_model" on traces, and show a small warning in billing preview when they diverge.
Jorge: telemetry tag SGTM. we can emit two fields: `client_pin_version` and `served_model_id`. add a dimension in datadog/hive to count mismatches. also we should sample full headers for one request per-minute per-tenant for debugging.
Maddie: UX idea: if mismatch rate > 0.1% for a tenant, show a non-blocking toast on the console: "Pinned version differs from model serving — costs may not match expectations" with a link to docs. Also add a red badge on billing preview if mismatch > 1%. keep copy light.
Eli: for billing safety we need to avoid charge surprises. suggestion: retroactively attribute tokens to pinned version for invoices within the grace window if mismatch is due to our fallback bug. requires billing pipeline change but may be needed for a 1-week window.
Priya: operationally we can add a fallback toggle in the console that forces strict honor of pin (even if higher latency/cost) until we fix the proxy. that would be per-tenant and visible in audit logs. implementation: route policy `pin.strict=true` that bypasses autoswitch.
Simran: timeline? I can ship a console toggle UI in a day if backend exposes the feature flag. Jorge, can proxy gate be added as a soft flag?
Jorge: yes, we can add `pin.strict` check and short-circuit to pinned pool. low-risk change, feature-flagged. will take ~2d to QA in staging and 4h to roll to prod behind a kill-switch.
Maddie: I'll draft toast copy and the billing preview hint. want wording to match "non-blocking, educational" pattern.
Eli: Finance wants a list of affected tenants by EOD. can we produce telemetry counts of mismatches and attach sample request ids?
Jorge: we can run a match query on traces where `client_pin_version != served_model_id` and export tenant + count + samples. will deliver a CSV.
Priya: ops note — when enabling `pin.strict` we should also enable an alert: "tenant-pin-mismatch-rate spike" to avoid hidden perf regressions. add runbook step to rollback if latency increases > 20%.
Simran: good call. also add an analytics event when tenant toggles `pin.strict` so product can study usage.
Maddie: UX question — should the toggle be in the same place as "pinned versions" or under an advanced policy panel? my take: under advanced with a clear tooltip. less accidental toggles.
Eli: agree advanced. also add a one-click "request invoice remediation" button that pings finance and attaches trace samples.
Simran: ok owner list: Jorge implements proxy flag + telemetry tags (owner Jorge), Priya implements alert/runbook (owner Priya), Maddie implements UI text + toggle placement (owner Maddie), Eli will coordinate finance remediation play (owner Eli). I'll create a follow-up RFC and a short staging test plan.
Jorge: quick technical note: do not rely on `x-forwarded-for` to carry pin — it can be rewritten by intermediate proxies. use internal header `x-rw-client-pin` and mark hop-only. also log `routing_decision={pinned|autoswitch|fallback}`.
Priya: will add SLO test to canary: enable `pin.strict` on small tenant in staging and run 5k requests to detect perf delta.
Maddie: draft toast copy in #design in 30m for quick review.
Eli: finance will pre-approve invoice remediation for tenants with >1000 mismatched tokens during the incident window.
Simran: thanks — next steps: Jorge + Priya + Maddie sync tomorrow 10am, I'll open the RFC and link it here. if anyone finds additional affected tenants, drop IDs here. :thumbsup:
